All cases and expected behaviors align with the requirements and their cited IDs. No blockers found.

analysis.analysis: For R-175: Normal scenario includes navigating to theme preferences and verifying both Classic and Modern themes exist. Edge and boundary scenarios include checking behavior when no themes are loaded or themes preferences is accessed with restricted permissions. Abnormal scenarios include missing theme options. For R-176: Normal scenario includes verifying Classic theme matches the given image. Edge scenarios include checking Classic theme display on minimum and maximum supported resolutions. Abnormal scenarios include incorrect rendering. For R-177: Normal scenario includes verifying Modern theme matches the given image. Edge scenarios include checking Modern theme display on boundary resolutions. Abnormal scenarios include incorrect rendering. For R-178: Normal scenario includes checking availability of Theme Preferences item under View menu. Abnormal scenarios include missing menu item. For R-179: Normal scenario includes checking availability of Get New Themes item under View menu. Abnormal scenarios include missing menu item. For R-180: Normal scenario includes checking availability of Classic item under View menu. Abnormal scenarios include missing menu item. For R-181: Normal scenario includes checking availability of Modern item under View menu. Abnormal scenarios include missing menu item.
